proposition: Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī checked the two earliest copies of the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ and was present at teaching sessions on the work, as colophons or audition certificates on those copies state; the Mafāḥiṣ was revised and expanded in Yazd in his company (timeline: 828/1425).

mediation.who: colophons and audition notes of MS Majlis 10196 and related manuscripts, as summarised in MK's timeline (fn. 1)
mediation.note: a colophon date may record copying, not composition; the timeline does not say which entries rest on colophons
